name: Toucan 0.0.4
body:
Toucan 0.0.4 fixes four rough edges around clearing colors, the sidebar and the experimental search emoji.

## Fixed

- **Clear Color leaves no empty settings behind.** When clearing a repo's color empties `workbench.colorCustomizations`, Toucan now removes the setting instead of leaving an empty `{}`. ([#12](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/12))
- **The secondary sidebar closes when Toucan's block goes away**, for example when the repo loses its color, but only if Toucan opened it. A sidebar you opened yourself, with Chat or other views, stays open. ([#12](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/12))
- **The search emoji works without an open file.** With no editor open, the search bar reads "🟦 webshop" instead of "🟦 — webshop". ([#12](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/12))
- **Disabling or uninstalling Toucan with the search emoji on no longer breaks your window title.** The emoji now uses Toucan's own title variables, which stay empty when Toucan isn't running, so there's no doubled name and no need to turn the emoji off first. If your own `window.title` uses `${activeRepositoryName}`, it shows source control's repository name again, as without Toucan. ([#12](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/12))

The version bump is [#13](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/13).

## Install

Download `toucan-0.0.4.vsix` below, then either:

- in VS Code: Extensions view → `…` → **Install from VSIX…**, or
- from a terminal: `code --install-extension toucan-0.0.4.vsix`

Installing over 0.0.3 keeps your settings. If you use the search emoji, Toucan updates the title it added to your `window.title` the next time the emoji shows.

SHA-256: `b139e00ef4d07559000a57c7237c4c9804e6c71152cc6399ab112511f69377d5`

## Good to know

- Not on the Marketplace yet.
- [v0.0.3](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/releases/tag/v0.0.3), [v0.0.2](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/releases/tag/v0.0.2) and [v0.0.1](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/releases/tag/v0.0.1) are still available.

The full review history of each change is in its PR.

🤖 MarcoGPT

name: Toucan 0.0.3
body:
Toucan 0.0.3 is a maintenance release. It works the same as 0.0.2, and a failure that used to go unnoticed is now logged.

## What's new

- **Failures are logged.** When work Toucan runs in the background fails, it now writes the error to its log instead of dropping it. Open it with **Output** → **Toucan**. ([#9](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/9))

## Changed

Behind the scenes, for contributors:

- **Rules and decisions in one place.** The project's architecture decisions now live in an ADR log ([`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/tree/main/docs/adr)), a test checks the log and every ADR the code cites, and the agent instructions are rewritten as short rules with pointers. Lint is type-aware with no warnings allowed, and a pre-push hook runs the checks. Docs search uses qmd with Toucan's own index. ([#7](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/7))
- **A layout where the path tells you what a file is:** `src/core/`, `src/shared/<topic>/` and `src/features/<feature>/`, with role suffixes. ([#8](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/8))
- **Upkeep:** errors are caught through one `tryCatch` helper, functions take one object argument, shared helpers replace duplicated code, imports are grouped under headers, and mutation testing with StrykerJS runs on demand (`pnpm mutate`). ([#9](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/9))
- **A `/docs-sync` skill** that finds documentation drift since its last run and proposes a fix for each item. ([#10](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/10))
- The version bump is [#11](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/11).

## Install

Download `toucan-0.0.3.vsix` below, then either:

- in VS Code: Extensions view → `…` → **Install from VSIX…**, or
- from a terminal: `code --install-extension toucan-0.0.3.vsix`

Installing over 0.0.2 keeps your settings.

SHA-256: `45f3ddfd54922271f9f0bea9f4cd807610ba7dd9adc3f5a82b92467fdd8e8591`

## Good to know

- Not on the Marketplace yet.
- [v0.0.2](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/releases/tag/v0.0.2) and [v0.0.1](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/releases/tag/v0.0.1) are still available.

The full review history of each change is in its PR. The maintenance run's plan and decisions are in [docs/plans/architecture-maintenance](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/tree/main/docs/plans/architecture-maintenance), and the docs-sync skill's in [docs/plans/docs-sync](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/tree/main/docs/plans/docs-sync).

🤖 MarcoGPT

name: Toucan 0.0.2
body:
Toucan 0.0.2 gives the extension its own icon and a hand-drawn glyph set.

## What's new

- **Extension icon and gallery banner.** The Toucan logo is now the extension's icon in VS Code's Extensions view, with a matching dark green banner. ([#3](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/3))
- **17 glyphs in Toucan's own style.** Every glyph is drawn in Toucan's own icon font: polygonal, with softened corners, filled, with the holes cut out. Set Glyph shows them in four groups. ([#4](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/4))

  | Group          | Glyphs                          |
  | -------------- | ------------------------------- |
  | Shapes         | square, bar, pill, circle       |
  | Toucan's world | toucan, sun, leaf, drop, moon   |
  | Characters     | alien, ghost, robot, cat        |
  | Fun & dev      | bolt, heart, star, rocket       |

- **The search bar emoji follows the glyph's shape:** circles for circle, hearts for heart, and squares for the rest.

## Changed

- **double-circle and check-circle are gone.** A repo still set to either shows as square, with a warning, so pick a new glyph with **Toucan: Set Glyph**.
- Behind the scenes:
  - the workflow actions moved to their current major versions ([#2](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/2))
  - CI and the release build share one check that every generated file (glyph font, icon, generated code) is up to date
  - the version bump is [#5](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/5)

## Install

Download `toucan-0.0.2.vsix` below, then either:

- in VS Code: Extensions view → `…` → **Install from VSIX…**, or
- from a terminal: `code --install-extension toucan-0.0.2.vsix`

Installing over 0.0.1 keeps your settings.

SHA-256: `076b01a359e2d7534b544697ddc7f6646279c613547366da7cc60757941fc11e`

## Good to know

- Not on the Marketplace yet.
- [v0.0.1](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/releases/tag/v0.0.1) is still available.

The full review history of each change is in its PR. The glyph set's design and decisions are in [docs/plans/glyph-set](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/tree/main/docs/plans/glyph-set).

🤖 MarcoGPT

name: Toucan 0.0.1
body:
The first release of Toucan: see at a glance which repository a VS Code window has open, without writing anything into the repo.

## What's in it

- **Command Center color** in the focused window, from user settings keyed by folder name. Missing colors (text, hover, border, inactive) are derived from the background.
- **Status bar indicator** in every window, focused or not: the repo's glyph and name in its color.
- **Commands:** Set Color, Pick Preset Color (16 toucan-themed presets), Set Glyph (8 shapes), Clear Color and Toggle Sidebar Block. Colors that may be hard to see on the status bar get a warning.
- **Opt-in sidebar color block** (always visible, or only when the window loses focus), and an **experimental search bar emoji**, which asks before changing `window.title`.
- **Comments survive:** Toucan edits only its own keys in settings.json when that's provably safe, and otherwise falls back to VS Code's own write.
- Works in Restricted Mode and in remote windows. Repo-provided text never reaches notifications.

## Install

Download `toucan-0.0.1.vsix` below, then either:

- in VS Code: Extensions view → `…` → **Install from VSIX…**, or
- from a terminal: `code --install-extension toucan-0.0.1.vsix`

Then run **Toucan: Pick Preset Color** in a repo.

SHA-256: `1c67b8ce800dc13cd07acdb9dd73a86a5aeead61f429ecadccbd6d6ccfb51c2d`

## Good to know

- Unfocused windows don't keep the Command Center color, because VS Code applies user-level colors to every window. The status bar indicator (and the optional sidebar block) mark them instead.
- VS Code's default compact Agents control hides the Command Center background. Toucan offers once to switch it to `badge`.
- Not on the Marketplace yet.

The full design and every decision are in [docs/plans/toucan-v1](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/tree/main/docs/plans/toucan-v1). The review history is in [#1](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/1) and [#2](https://github.com/Marco-Daniel/Toucan/pull/2).

🤖 MarcoGPT
